task: Welcome to TextWorld! Here is how to play! First thing I need you to do is to make sure that the chest drawer is opened. Then, recover the old key from the chest drawer in the bedroom. And then, insert the old key into the wooden door's lock to unlock it. After unlocking the wooden door, ensure that the wooden door in the bedroom is open. Then, head east. After that, make absolutely sure that the screen door within the kitchen is ajar. After that, move east. Then, head south. And then, recover the milk from the floor of the garden. If you can get your hands on the milk, make an attempt to travel north. Once you get through with that, try to move west. And then, place the milk on the stove inside the kitchen. Alright, thanks!
